title: Inline line grid: the column-header help text becomes part of every cell's announced column name
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZrgaiMgTJCnswR6jQ

Follow-up of #35804 (PR #35998). Optional nit from L1-a, record 7058316549.

## Problem
The inline line grid's column-header help button sits inside the `<th>`, and the help text is its `aria-label`. That label joins the column header's computed accessible name. A screen reader announcing a cell's column header may therefore read the whole help sentence with every cell in that column.

## Done when
- The header's accessible name stays the field label, plus at most a short "Help" word.
- The help text stays reachable by keyboard and screen reader, through `aria-describedby` on the button or through the tooltip content, in the reader's language.
- A pin reads the column header's accessible name (label only) and the button's description (the help).

## Where
`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.tsx` (`ColumnHeaderHelp`) and its tests.
